verdict.rationale: Modal documents custom images for sandboxes: marketing says "Custom images, any dependency", and the JS/Go SDK guide shows creating a Sandbox "with the specified Image". Snapshots could serve as reusable templates, but they are created via an experimental `._experimental_snapshot()` API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bringing your own existing container image (e.g., from a registry or Dockerfile), a first-class reusable sandbox template mechanism beyond experimental snapshots, and independent or hands-on corroboration of custom-image usage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define custom sandbox templates or bring my own container image

citations.quote: Create a Sandbox with the specified Image, and mount a Volume
A `SandboxSnapshot` object lets you interact with a stored Sandbox snapshot that was created by calling `._experimental_snapshot()` on a Sandbox instance.
